product_metadata.title: VASAGLE Industrial Coat Shoe Rack Hall Tree with 9 Hooks, Steel Frame Pipe Style, 39.4 x 16.3 x 71.7 inches, Greige
features: [Welcomes You Home] Eliminate the mess in your hallway with this smart coat and shoe rack; featuring a perfect balance between the simple silhouette, industrial pipe flair, and effortlessly rustic appeal

[Everything You Need] After coming back home at the end of the day, just hang your coat, hat, or scarf on any of 4 dual hooks or 5 tri-hooks, sit on the bench to remove your shoes, and put them on any of 2 steel mesh storage shelves

[Something Else?] A full-length, 38.2” hanging rail on top equals a tiny wardrobe—put up some hangers for your suit jacket, shirt, or outwear you need every workday, keeping them crease-free and giving them more space

[Strength to Support] Without a sturdy structure, all the storage functions are pointless. Durable particleboard supported by steel pipes ensures a robust piece that holds 220 lb on the bench, 44 lb per mesh shelf, and 6.6 lb per hook
[What's in the Pack] An industrial-design hall tree from our DAINTREE Collection, adjustable feet, an anti-tip kit, and a simple assembly process with clear instructions and numbered parts
description: Liven Up Your SpaceInstead of a boring piece, this coat rack from VASAGLE, featuring greige boards, industrial pipe tubes, and steel mesh shelves, gives your hallway a rustic look and lends a charming flair to your room. It’ll surely make a statement when guests drop by.

One for AllHats, scarves, and keys go on the 9 hooks, coats go on the top rail, bags go on the top shelf, and shoes go on the mesh shelves—all of your out-of-door items are under control on this coat rack— even you! The sturdy top shelf with a maximum load capacity of 220 lb allows you to sit down comfortably as you change shoes.

Specifications:- Color: Greige, Black- Material: Particleboard, Steel- Product Size: 16.3”L x 39.4”W x 71.7”H (41 x 100 x 182 cm)- Product Weight: 35.1 lb (15.9 kg)- Max. Load Capacity of Shoe Bench: 220 lb (100 kg)- Max. Load Capacity of Each Mesh Shelf: 44 lb (20 kg)- Max. Load Capacity of Each Hook: 6.6 lb (3 kg)
Package Contents:- 1 x Coat Rack- 1 x Accessory Kit- 1 x Anti-Tip Kit- 1 x Instructions

VASAGLE Notes:- The product should be attached to the wall with the anti-tipping kit for safety.- Don’t hang heavy clothing or other overweight items on the top rail or hooks.- The max. load capacity of the bench is 220 lb. Don’t exceed its weight limit.
